name: Radar (Spider) Chart
summary: Benchmark the target against peers across 4–8 metrics at once: target as a filled accent polygon, peers as thin outlines, optional peer-median polygon.
summary_zh: 在 4–8 个维度上同时对标目标公司与同业：目标公司为 accent-2 填充多边形，同业为细线轮廓，可叠加同业中位数虚线多边形。
description_zh: 用于同业对标页的“综合评分”视图：每条轴是一个指标（增长、利润率、ROIC、杠杆、ESG…），每个多边形是一家公司，离中心越远得分越高。目标公司以 accent-2 填充并在顶点标注数值，同业用细线（彩色或灰色），可加同业中位数虚线作为基准。支持长表（company / metric / score）与宽表（encode.axis 为字段数组，每行一个多边形，各轴沿用字段格式）。轴最大值可统一（如 100 分制）或按轴自动取整；图例可点选显示 / 隐藏公司，点击多边形可交叉筛选。
best_for: Peer scorecards on a common 0–100 scale
Target vs. peer median across operating metrics
avoid_when: More than ~6 companies or ~8 metrics (use a heatmap table)
Metrics on very different scales without normalisation
Precise value comparison is the point (use bars)

axis.desc: Long data: metric-name field; wide data: array of numeric fields (one axis each)

target.desc: Flag field marking the target polygon

highlight.desc: Series value(s) drawn filled in accent-2 (in addition to rows flagged by encode.target)

max.desc: null = nice max per axis | number = common max (e.g. 100) | {axis: max}

min.desc: Axis minimum; extended automatically when data falls below it (null = nice min from data)

format.desc: Value format (long data); wide data uses each field's own format

legend.desc: Legend (vertical at top-left on wide blocks); click to show / hide a company

interactions: Hover a polygon: every metric with delta vs. peer median

samples.title: Operating profile vs. Industrial Automation peers (wide data)
